topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and outlines the learning outcomes for the cancer therapy lecture.

topics.label: Conventional therapeutic modalities and cytotoxic chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore standard non-targeted cancer treatments and the clinical challenges of systemic toxicity and drug resistance.

topics.label: Exploiting intrinsic cellular defects and vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine therapeutic approaches that exploit intrinsic signaling dependencies, checkpoint defects, and DNA repair deficiencies in cancer cells.

topics.label: Oncogene addiction and small-molecule kinase inhibitors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on targeting hyperactivated oncogenic kinases and the mechanisms driving acquired resistance and signaling bypass.

topics.label: Antibody-based therapeutics and targeted drug delivery
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the design and application of antibody-based agents for direct receptor targeting and selective toxin delivery.

topics.label: Cancer immunotherapy and engineered cellular therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the role of the immune system in cancer surveillance and methods for therapeutically activating and engineering immune responses.

topics.label: Clinical challenges, future directions, and treatment outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate broader systemic challenges in oncology, historical improvements in patient survival, and emerging directions in cancer care.
